description: This file contains unit tests for the HandleBusMessage class, which processes GStreamer bus messages in a media playback context. It tests handling of various message types such as EOS, state changes, QoS, and errors, ensuring correct notification and state management within the media pipeline.

classes.name: HandleBusMessageTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for handling GStreamer bus message tests, setting up mock objects and media pipeline elements.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageWithUnknownType
methods.description: Tests that messages with unknown types are unrefed and not processed further.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleEosMessageForAnotherPipeline
methods.description: Ensures EOS messages from a different pipeline are ignored.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageEosWhenPipelineIsNull
methods.description: Checks that EOS messages are ignored if the pipeline is null.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageEosWhenEosAlreadyNotified
methods.description: Verifies that EOS notification is not repeated if already notified.

methods.name: shouldHandleEosMessage
methods.description: Tests handling of EOS message, expecting notification of end of stream.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleStateChangedMessageForAnotherPipeline
methods.description: Ensures state change messages from a different pipeline are ignored.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleMessageStateChangedWhenPipelineIsNull
methods.description: Checks that state change messages are ignored if pipeline is null.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleStateChangedMessageWhenGstPlayerClientIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that state change messages are ignored if the client callback is null.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToNullMessage
methods.description: Tests handling of state change to NULL, expecting STOPPED notification.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPausedMessage
methods.description: Tests handling of state change to PAUSED, expecting PAUSED notification.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPausedAndPendingPausedMessage
methods.description: Verifies handling of paused state with pending state, no notification expected.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPlayingMessage
methods.description: Tests handling of state change to PLAYING, expecting PLAYING notification and timer start.

methods.name: shouldHandleStateChangedToPlayingMessageAndSetPendingPlaybackRate
methods.description: Verifies that pending playback rate is set when transitioning to PLAYING.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleQosMessageForUnsupportedFormat
methods.description: Ensures QoS messages with undefined format are ignored.

methods.name: shouldNotHandleQosMessageForUnknownSourceType
methods.description: Checks that QoS messages from unknown source types are ignored.

methods.name: shouldHandleQosMessageForVideo
methods.description: Tests QoS message handling for video source, expecting notification.

methods.name: shouldHandleQosMessageForAudio
methods.description: Tests QoS message handling for audio source, expecting notification.

methods.name: shouldHandleErrorMessageNoEos
methods.description: Verifies error message handling results in FAILURE notification when not all sources are EOS.

methods.name: shouldHandleErrorMessageWhenEosAllSources
methods.description: Checks that error from a source triggers END_OF_STREAM if all sources are EOS.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageNoEos
methods.description: Ensures stream error results in FAILURE if not all sources are EOS.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageWhenEosSingleSource
methods.description: Verifies that stream error from a source triggers END_OF_STREAM if all sources are EOS.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageWhenEosAllSources
methods.description: Checks that stream error from a source triggers END_OF_STREAM when all sources are EOS.

methods.name: shouldHandleStreamErrorMessageWhenEosAllSourcesAndEosAlreadyNotfied
methods.description: Verifies no duplicate END_OF_STREAM notification if already notified when all sources are EOS.
